% Generated by scripts/audit_undergraduate.py from Teach definitions.
\newglossaryentry{program}{name={program},description={is instructions written in a form a computer can carry out. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:program}; see also \glslink{function}{\glsentryname{function}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{input}{name={input},description={is the starting information supplied to it. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:program}; see also \glslink{output}{\glsentryname{output}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{output}{name={output},description={is the resulting information we read, such as the word “on.”. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:program}; see also \glslink{input}{\glsentryname{input}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{execution}{name={execution},description={means carrying out the program's instructions. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:program}; see also \glslink{trace}{\glsentryname{trace}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{rule}{name={rule},description={is an explicit instruction specifying an allowed operation. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:program}; see also \glslink{computation}{\glsentryname{computation}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{computation}{name={computation},description={carries out specified rules on represented information to obtain a result. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:program}; see also \glslink{rule}{\glsentryname{rule}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{threshold}{name={threshold},description={is a chosen boundary used in making a decision. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:boundary}; see also \glslink{condition}{\glsentryname{condition}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{condition}{name={condition},description={is a statement checked as true or false. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:boundary}; see also \glslink{threshold}{\glsentryname{threshold}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{trace}{name={trace},description={is a record of the steps and values in one execution. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:boundary}; see also \glslink{execution}{\glsentryname{execution}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{context}{name={context},description={means the relevant current situation in which an operation is selected or carried out. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:boundary}; see also \glslink{condition}{\glsentryname{condition}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{Python}{name={Python},description={is the programming language used here. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:code}; see also \glslink{program}{\glsentryname{program}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{function}{name={function},description={is a named, reusable rule in this program. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:code}; see also \glslink{program}{\glsentryname{program}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{cell}{name={cell},description={is a basic living unit. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:biology}; see also \glslink{genome}{\glsentryname{genome}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{molecule}{name={molecule},description={is atoms joined by chemical bonds: small constituents of matter held together by chemical connections. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:biology}; see also \glslink{dna}{\glsentryname{dna}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{dna}{name={DNA},description={is deoxyribonucleic acid, a molecule that carries genetic information. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:biology}; see also \glslink{molecule}{\glsentryname{molecule}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{genome}{name={genome},description={is an organism's complete set of DNA. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:biology}; see also \glslink{gene}{\glsentryname{gene}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{rna}{name={RNA},description={means ribonucleic acid, a related molecule that can carry information from DNA and perform cellular roles. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:biology}; see also \glslink{protein}{\glsentryname{protein}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{protein}{name={protein},description={is a molecule built from smaller units called amino acids; proteins do many structural and working jobs in cells. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:biology}; see also \glslink{rna}{\glsentryname{rna}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{gene}{name={gene},description={is a DNA region whose information is used to make a functional RNA or, through RNA, a protein. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:biology}; see also \glslink{expression}{\glsentryname{expression}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{expression}{name={gene expression},description={is the use of a gene's information to produce RNA or protein. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:biology}; see also \glslink{regulation}{\glsentryname{regulation}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{regulation}{name={gene regulation},description={is control over when, where or how much that expression occurs. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:biology}; see also \glslink{expression}{\glsentryname{expression}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{analogy}{name={analogy},description={is a comparison highlighting a limited resemblance between different things. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:analogy}; see also \glslink{computational-gene}{\glsentryname{computational-gene}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{computational-gene}{name={computational gene},description={is a proposed named software unit, not a DNA molecule. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:analogy}; see also \glslink{analogy}{\glsentryname{analogy}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{research-program}{name={research program},description={is a coordinated set of questions, proposed explanations and tests. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:research}; see also \glslink{hypothesis}{\glsentryname{hypothesis}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{hypothesis}{name={hypothesis},description={is a claim precise enough to be tested and potentially contradicted. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:research}; see also \glslink{evidence}{\glsentryname{evidence}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{baseline}{name={baseline},description={is an ordinary comparison method against which a proposal is assessed. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:research}; see also \glslink{hypothesis}{\glsentryname{hypothesis}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{evidence}{name={evidence},description={is an observation or reason bearing on a stated claim. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:research}; see also \glslink{hypothesis}{\glsentryname{hypothesis}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{representation}{name={representation},description={is a chosen way to express information through distinguishable forms. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:roadmap}; see also \glslink{information}{\glsentryname{information}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{information}{name={information},description={here means what a chosen description tells us about the possibilities relevant to a task. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:roadmap}; see also \glslink{representation}{\glsentryname{representation}}.}}
